# Review CHANGES REQUESTED for PAN-5471

# Review — PAN-5471
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — the PR body lacks the Mintlify validation output that NFR-2 and the PRD's Validation criterion require

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-5471-review-2b799da7
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5471/.pan/review/agent-pan-5471-review-2b799da7/context.json
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-5471 / /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5471
- PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5521
- HEAD reviewed: 2b799da74ae2ed81f118432d84885f647e45acca
- Base / prior cycle SHA: merge-base 6e56c03df91d01e6ba9ff953f1051501afea08fc; no prior cycle

## Blocking Findings

### [requirements] Mintlify validation output is not in the PR body — PR #5521 description
- Severity: !
- Classification / requirement scope: validation gap; in_pr_scope (explicit acceptance criterion).
- Requirement: PRD `.pan/drafts/PAN-5471.md` NFR-2 says "`npx mint validate` and `npx mint broken-links` report no errors for the touched files; results pasted in the PR body". Its Acceptance criteria section repeats: "Validation: ... outputs are in the PR body". The Validation paragraph names the heading `Docs validation`.
- Observed: the PR #5521 body has only the eight-item AC checklist. It has no `Docs validation` section and no mint output.
- Impact: the operator and later review cycles cannot see the validation record the PRD promises. The checks themselves pass when I run them on this HEAD (see Verification), so the site is not broken.
- Evidence: `gh pr view 5521 --json body`. The spec's `.acN` checks do not require the paste, so `pan done` did not catch it. The requirement comes from the PRD.
- Fix: add a `## Docs validation` section to the PR body with the output of both commands from the PRD's Validation paragraph: `npx mint validate --no-build --files ...` and `npx mint broken-links --files ... --check-anchors`. The broken-links run reports an unrelated pre-existing parse error in `configuration/mcp.mdx`; note it as unrelated.

## Non-blocking Findings

Fix the next two in the same cycle. Each one changes a fact-sheet statement, so FR-1 ("every factual claim traces to a fact F-1 to F-36") is met except for these two lines.

### [requirements] Crew label misquoted — `configuration/model-routing.mdx:202`
- Severity: ~
- Classification / scope: implementation defect (doc departs from F-31), in_pr_scope.
- Observed: the page says a crew is labelled "`<slot> to <model>` for a workhorse reference". F-31 says `<slot> → <model>`, which is close to the code. `crewLabel` in `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/Settings/sections/tiered-crews.ts:229-233` renders `` `${crew.model} → ${name}` ``, so the UI shows `workhorse:mid → Claude Opus 5.5`. The arrow is not a dash, so D-9 did not require replacing it, and D-12 asks for exact UI labels. F-31 is loose only on `<slot>` versus `workhorse:<slot>`.
- Fix: write `` `workhorse:<slot> → <model name>` ``.

### [correctness] `pan doctor` provider check scope overstated — `configuration/model-routing.mdx:158`
- Severity: ~
- Classification / scope: implementation defect (minor doc inaccuracy), in_pr_scope.
- Observed: the page says "`pan doctor` flags a role or crew model whose provider is not enabled". `src/cli/commands/doctor-tier-fitness.ts:40-60` checks only the tier (crew) models, or `roles.work.model` when tiering is off. Plan, review and other role models are not checked. F-19 says "a crew model or `roles.work.model`".
- Fix: replace "a role or crew model" with "a crew model, or `roles.work.model` when tiered execution is off".

### [ux] Repeated and mismatched sentences in "Settings saved but not acted on yet" — `configuration/model-routing.mdx:271-285`
- Severity: ≉ (prose)
- Line 271 ("Overdeck validates and saves a few settings whose effects do not run yet.") repeats the required verbatim sentence on line 273. Line 284 opens with "Both are tracked here" after a four-item list. Dropping line 271 and rewording line 284 to "These are tracked in [#5517] and [#4512]." would fix both.

### [requirements] Mintlify output missing from the PR body (NFR-2)
- Severity: ~ (process; the underlying check passes)
- NFR-2 and the Validation AC ask for the scoped `mint validate` and `mint broken-links` results to be pasted in the PR body. The PR body has only the AC checklist. I ran both checks on this HEAD: they pass (see Verification), so only the pasted record is missing.

### [nit] Step 4 wording — `configuration/model-routing.mdx:22-23`
- "Whichever of the steps above resolves first, if the result is a workhorse reference..." reads awkwardly. "If the result of steps 1 to 3 is a workhorse reference..." is clearer. Optional.

### [nit] Small wording departures from the fact sheet (optional)
- Line 163, "native to Anthropic": the code checks `builtInHarness === 'claude-code'` (harness-resolve.ts:118). Per F-17, that also covers Ollama models. The code comment says "(Anthropic)", so this is close enough. "native to `claude-code`" would be exact.
- Line 246, "every other live slot agent": `fireTieredCommitHooks` (swarm-tiered-hooks.ts:119-131) sends to every live assigned slot agent and does not exclude the merged slot's own agent. F-28 says "every live slot agent".
- Line 183, "a config error": the error comes from `resolveTieredExecutionEnabled` and concerns the plan's `plan.metadata.tiered_execution`, not `config.yaml` (tier-table.ts:134). "an error" would match F-21.

## Coverage

### Changed-file ledger
| File | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| configuration/model-routing.mdx | reviewed | I checked the claims listed under "Fact checks" and the places where the wording goes beyond the fact sheet. The rest rely on the PRD fact sheet (verified 2026-11-18 at 76237b3febb). Two `~` inaccuracies and three nits, listed above. |
| configuration/harnesses.mdx | reviewed | Both D-8 replacements applied. Stale strings removed. Harness order matches `resolveHarness`. |
| configuration/model-presets.mdx | reviewed | Link added after the intro. All 3 en dashes fixed; 0 left in the file. |
| configuration/effort.mdx | reviewed | One sentence added after the precedence table; the anchor `#tiered-execution` exists. |
| concepts.mdx | reviewed | Only `## Multi-Model Routing` changed: renamed and body replaced (D-7). |
| features/cloister.mdx | reviewed | Routing section, intro bullet and description replaced; Related Guides link added; em dashes fixed. Diagram, triggers table and JSON examples left alone for PAN-5472/PAN-5502, as the PRD says. |
| docs.json | reviewed | One line added: `configuration/model-routing` directly before `configuration/model-presets`. |
| docs/MODEL_ROUTING.md | reviewed | One banner line added with a relative link. |
| .overdeck/context/codebase/architecture.md | reviewed | Outside the WIs but correct: `src/lib/cloister/router.ts` no longer exists; `resolveModel` (roles.ts:122) and `resolveStaffing` (staffing.ts:128) exist. |
| .pan/drafts/PAN-5471.md, .pan/specs/…xbrief.json, .pan/continues/PAN-5471.xbrief.json | not applicable | Planning artifacts; read the PRD as the requirement source. |

### Fact checks against code (HEAD)
- `model_selection` / `complexity_routing` are only a type and default in `src/lib/cloister/config.ts`, and nothing reads them. So "Overdeck ignores those keys" is true.
- `resolveHarness` ignores the role (comment at harness-resolve.ts:79). Order is explicit, then provider default, then built-in (line 93). An explicit denied pick throws (lines 108-111). The fallback goes to claude-code only when the built-in default is claude-code (lines 118-130).
- `pan start --model/--harness/--tier/--plan-model` flags match `start-register.ts:14-22`. `--tier` is the remote resiliency tier.
- `--model` skips tier selection in both single-work and swarm-slot paths (`spawn-prep.ts:247` and `:501-504`). So "Either way" is accurate.
- `GET /api/models/resolve` exists (project-routes.ts:398-403).
- `DEFAULT_SUPERVISOR_SAMPLE_RATE = 0.25` (tier-supervisor.ts:56) matches "25%".
- The doctor message "tiered_execution is invalid and has been disabled" exists (doctor-tier-fitness.ts:32).
- The `N-model mix` crew label matches (tiered-crews.ts:230). The workhorse label is misquoted (see finding).
- The role default table matches `DEFAULT_MODEL_REFS` and `DEFAULT_ROLES` (roles.ts:19-63), including the review lanes and flywheel `effort: high`. Workhorse defaults match `DEFAULT_WORKHORSES` (roles.ts:34-38).
- "fails config load" for an undefined slot (line 49) is accurate. `validateRoleModelRefs` (roles.ts:333) runs from merge.ts:1025 at load and calls `derefWorkhorse`, which throws the quoted message (roles.ts:114).

### Requirement source
The manifest's `acceptanceCriteria` array is empty. I used the PRD's "Acceptance criteria" and "Requirements" sections and the spec's `.acN` sub-items (8 items, 2 to 5 checks each). The spec's checks are a subset of the PRD's criteria. They do not include the PR-body paste.

### Dimensions
- Correctness: the claims above were traced to code. Only the two minor inaccuracies above were found.
- Security: not applicable. Docs only. External links go to discord.gg and github.com; there are no secrets.
- Performance: not applicable. Docs only, and no build-impacting changes beyond one nav entry.
- Requirements/UX: see AC matrix. All non-goals are respected. No source, UI or config changes. No promotion, replay, call-out or blocking-supervisor behavior is described outside the "not acted on yet" list. No per-role harness routing claim, no standing tier sessions, no CLI tiered flag, no changelog.d entry, no screenshot on the new page, and no blog edits.

### AC-to-evidence matrix
| AC | Status | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| WI-1 model-routing page | met (FR-1 except lines 158 and 202, see `~` findings) | Description is 138 chars. The 10 H2s and 6 H3s are in D-2 order. 0 U+2013/U+2014 in the page. Must-not grep returns nothing. All four verbatim sentences are present (lines 244, 273, 313, 315). Required strings are present (`pan admin config tiers`, `models.providers`, `workhorse:mid`, `plan.metadata.tiered_execution`, the Discord link, 5517, 4512). lint:docs and the scoped mint checks pass. |
| WI-2 docs.json | met | `configuration/model-routing` directly precedes `configuration/model-presets` in the same pages array. CI build passes. |
| WI-3 cloister | met | 0 matches for the six banned strings. Links `/configuration/model-routing`. 0 dashes in the file. New description is 86 chars. |
| WI-4 concepts | met | 0 matches for `Multi-Model Routing` and `based on task type`. Link present. |
| WI-5 harnesses | met | 0 matches for the four banned strings. Two links to `/configuration/model-routing`. |
| WI-6 presets | met | Link present; 0 dashes in the file. |
| WI-7 effort | met | Links `/configuration/model-routing#tiered-execution`, and the anchor exists. |
| WI-8 MODEL_ROUTING.md | met | The banner links `../configuration/model-routing.mdx`. |
| Validation (NFR-2) | unmet | Both mint commands pass on this HEAD (below), but the PRD also requires their outputs in the PR body, and they are not there (blocking finding). |
| NFR-1 dashes | met | 0 dashes in the new page, presets and cloister. 0 dashes in added lines of effort, harnesses, concepts and MODEL_ROUTING.md. |
| NFR-3 lint:docs | met | `docs lint passed (88 docs files, 86 published pages, 0 changelog entries)`. |
| NFR-4 no source changes | met | The diff touches only .mdx, docs.json, docs/*.md, the context map and .pan artifacts. |

## Verification
- `gh pr checks 5521` on HEAD 2b799da7: all required jobs pass (build (22), lint, lint-group core/effect/skills/state, test, test-shard 1-4, test-e2e, bare-host-linux, Clean install + server smoke test, Prompt change trailer gate). `overdeck/test` reports "Verification gate passed (typecheck+lint; tests run on CI)". CodeRabbit was rate limited, which is advisory.
- `npm run lint:docs`: passed.
- `npx mint validate --no-build --files <7 touched files>`: "success passed with 5 warnings". All 5 are `duplicate-h1`, which D-1 accepts.
- `npx mint broken-links --files <6 touched mdx> --check-anchors`: "no broken links found in the files that parsed". One unrelated pre-existing parse error is in `configuration/mcp.mdx`, which this PR does not touch.
- `npm run lint:effect-diagnostics`: not applicable. This is a docs-only change with no TypeScript or Effect impact.
- The full test suite was not run, by policy. CI ran it on this HEAD.
